title: Mine Says ZERO Feet Away 📍
premise: In a town where every phone shows how far across you are from your nearest family, mine says zero in my first apartment four hundred miles from home, while footsteps overhead keep step with mine.
twist: My mom moved in upstairs the week I left and has walked every step I take right over my head, so the phone can never tell us apart.
world: A bright one-room apartment in a brick walk-up: cream walls, a coral couch, a butter-yellow fridge, a teal kitchen corner, a mint stairwell with a landing, and the lilac flat upstairs.
